options.prompt: One concept art that fixes the screen layout of the lobby scene (Scene_Lobby) of the game 'Kitchen Riot'. Art style, identical for every asset in this game: Casual theme - chunky rounded vector outlines, glossy highlights, flat colour fills with at most two shading steps, no gradient, no airbrush, no texture noise, no visible brush strokes. Match the attached game concept art reference for palette and character proportions. Viewpoint: pure 2D side view, camera level with the characters, never top-down or three-quarter. Format: landscape 16:9 (game target 1920x1080), fully opaque background, floor line fixed at the bottom 20 percent of the frame. Background is a bright kitchen counter kept low saturation (25 percent or less) and lightness 75 to 85 percent; characters use bright high-value colours. Draw the selectable chefs standing at centre and the UI (character select, start button, settings button, lock marks on locked characters) at their real on-screen positions. No text other than UI labels, no watermark, no pixel art. Subject: Lobby layout of Scene_Lobby: a bright low-saturation kitchen counter background, the chibi knife chef standing at centre on the floor line. Left of centre a large rounded card showing the knife chef with a glowing selected frame; right of centre a matching card showing the ketchup-gun chef greyed out with a padlock mark over it. Bottom centre a big rounded green START button; top-right a round gear settings button; top-left a small badge showing a best-room number. No other text. Landscape 16:9, 1920x1080, opaque background.
